lead.safe: We checked the address, its registration and the page itself.
lead.suspicious: We found warning signs. Don't enter personal or payment details on this site.
lead.fraud: Don't open it, and don't enter any details on it.
lead.official: This is a verified official website.

check.disguise_note: Only the part in bold is the real website. Everything before it can be made up to look official.
check.offline: This site is offline now. It was judged on its address and registration records.
check.advice_dont_open: Don't open the link, and don't reply to the message.
check.advice_no_details: Never enter card details, passwords or one-time codes.
check.advice_bank: If you already entered card details, call your bank now on the number printed on your card.
check.advice_safe: No check is perfect. Never share one-time codes, even on a site that looks official.
check.error_no_link: We couldn't find a link in that text. Paste the full link or the whole message.
check.error_unavailable_title: We couldn't check this link right now
check.error_unavailable: Try again in a minute. Until then, don't enter any personal details on it.

mode.sample_hint: The API is not running, so the sample cases are shown.

model.title: AI model
model.unavailable: No trained model is available yet.
